en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European small town in a hilly rural landscape. In the foreground are dense rows of multi‑storey houses with steep gabled roofs, some half‑timbered. Further back stand detached villas and farmhouses, fields, orchards, and tree‑covered hills. A large neo‑Gothic church with a tall spire dominates the center of the scene, surrounded by several prominent civic or school‑like buildings. The horizon shows patchwork farmland and forest. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.
